p.span: Leave the everyday behind and dive into action. Wood Haven offers a complete immersion between lake and forest through exclusive outdoor experiences. Whether you seek the adrenaline of motorsports, the thrill of high-altitude challenges, or the tranquility of a twilight paddle, every activity is an invitation to reconnect with the wild.

p.span: The great lake of Wood Haven is your endless playground. Glide across the calm morning waters on a kayak or paddleboard, or get your adrenaline pumping at the helm of a jet ski carving through the waves. From an invigorating swim off our natural beach to boat rides under the golden evening light, experience the vastness of the lake in all its forms.

h2.span: From the Canopy to Rugged Trails

div.class: o_animate o_anim_fade_in o_visible o_anim_from_bottom o_grid_item o_colored_level g-col-lg-5 g-height-3 col-lg-5 order-lg-0
div.p: Set out to conquer our immense pine forest. Take to the skies on our dizzying treetop adventure course, race down wild trails on an electric mountain bike, or rev your engines during an off-road SSV buggy exploration. For moments of intense connection, challenge your loved ones on our unique padel court, nestled right at the edge of the woods.
